fallback_text: UA 1187 on Tue, Oct 20 moved 45 minutes later: departs 11:40 AM instead of 10:55 AM, arrives in San Francisco 3:05 PM instead of 2:20 PM. The gate was C112; the new gate isn’t known yet (it’s announced about 90 minutes before departure).
